id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the grid.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

hiddenSeries.description: A list of hidden series id.

defaultColors.description:
A list of default colors.
If a series doesn't have specified color it will take color from this list of foundation design tokens in order.
slate-50, blue-60, cyan-40, purple-50, plum-70, forest-40, choco-60, cyan-60, plum-30, olive-50, purple-70, forest-70

backgroundStyle.description: The background style for the chart.

height.description: The height of the component in pixels.

tooltipValuesDecimalPrecision.description: The decimal precision to show on tooltip values.

tooltipUnitEnabled.description: Whether or not to show units in tooltip

toolboxDataZoom.description:
Data area zooming. If set to `true`, a zoom icon will be displayed in the
toolbox and users will be able to zoom in by dragging within the chart area.

data.description: Holds the data to display in the grid.

grid.description:
Configuration for the grid.
Includes left, right, top, bottom padding for the chart

legend.description: The chart legend - information for each series.

zoomEnabled.description:
Whether to allow users to zoom the chart data via a scrubber tool
displayed directly below the chart.

defaultChartType.description:
The default type of chart to be displayed. This is a fallback value used
when a series does not have a specific series type configured.

showDownloadOptions.description:
Show a dropdown menu in the chart header to download the chart.
The user can choose to download one of the following file types: .png, .jpeg, .csv

showDataLabelsToggle.description: Show a toggle next to the download options that will display data labels

stackBars.description: If `true`, stack all series whose series type is `'bar'`.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the grid has no data.

chartActionsCollapseThreshold.description: The number of actions to display on the chart header.

csvMissingDataFiller.description: What is used to fill in missing seriesData when exporting to .csv data

showTimeZoneLabel.description: Whether or not to show the timezone label below chart.

timeZoneLabel.description:
The label to display below the chart.
By default the label is the time zone configured for the component. But it can be overridden setting a value here.

timeZoneNameFormat.description:
The format to use for the time zone label.
- [longGeneric](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/DateTimeFormat/DateTimeFormat#longgeneric): Display the time zone name in long format (e.g. "Pacific Time").
- [shortGeneric](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/DateTimeFormat/DateTimeFormat#shortgeneric): Display the time zone name in short format (e.g. "PT").
Default value is 'longGeneric'.

eventDataSpec.description: The specification used to retrieve event data displayed by this chart.

evalDataSpec.description:
The specification used to retrieve data displayed by this chart.
Note: evalDataSpec takes priviledge over dataSpec. Developer cannot combine both.
If `evalDataSpec` and `dataSpec` are both defined, `evalDataSpec` will be used and `dataSpec` will be ignored.

showCrosshair.description:
Whether or not to show crosshairs on hovering the chart, these will snap to the nearest point based on both X and Y axis.
It will also have a tooltip on the axes to show the date and value.

xAxis.description:
Only timeseries chart will have xAxis component configuration.  Categorical charts will define their
X-axis configuration in the dataSpec types.

showNowLine.description: Whether or not to display the "now" line on the chart.

collapseXAxis.description:
Whether or not to enable collapsible xAxis feature.
Warning - This is a private, unreleased feature. Use it at your own risk.

nowLineConfig.description: Style configurations of vertical line at the "now" point of time according to the interval of data being plotted.

dateLines.description: Configuration to add vertical line at any date on the graph.

dateLinesDataSpec.description: Configurations to add vertical line at any date on the graph requiring a fetch call.

hideMissingDataPoints.description: Whether or not to plot and show data at timestamps where there are 100% missing values.

noTimeZoneConversion.description:
Timezone configuration for displayed data.
E.g. if an event happened at 1am EST, we will show the event as happened at 1am to browsers in any timezone.

showAllTimestampInfoOnTooltip.description:
Whether to show all information of timestamp on tooltip when hovering over on a chart.
This configuration will show all information of a timestamp regardless of the
display interval.

E.g. if INTERVAL = 'YEAR' and timestamp = 2023-01-01T00:00:00
if `false`, tooltip will show 2023
if `true`, tooltip will show Jan 1, 2023 12:00:00 AM

showStartAndEndDate.description: Whether or not to show the start date of the chart.

displayStartDate.description: Start date displayed in the chart shown only when dataSelection is enabled.

displayEndDate.description: End date displayed in the chart shown only when dataSelection is enabled.

displayInterval.description:
Interval display value in the chart shown only when dataSelection is enabled.
Internal use only.

displayIntervalOptions.description: Interval display options in the chart shown only when dataSelection is enabled.

shouldOverrideUserConfigIdWithDataGenera.description: Whether or not to override user config ID with data generated ID.

dataSelection.description: Whether or not to show the data selector. For example, the date range and interval selectors.

dataSelectionControlsDataZoom.description:
when this boolean turns true, it means we use the data selection inputs to control the data zoom
it changes the chart range but does not make a new API call.

dataZoomStartValue.description: Start value used in the datazoom to filter a certain range of chart.

dataZoomEndValue.description: End value used in the datazoom to filter a certain range of chart.

synchronized.description:
If true, displays each chart series on a separate chart grid, while sychronizing the ability to view
information such as x-axis value and tooltip across series.

suppressOrderSeriesById.description:
If true, order the series in whatever order they are returned from the server. By default, the series
will be ordered alphanumerically by ID.

noDataComponentId.description: The id of the component to show when there is no data.

selectedPartNumber.description: The {@link InventorySeries#partNumber} of the part currently plotted on the chart.

zoomRangeStart.description: The start of the zoom range.

zoomRangeEnd.description: The end of the zoom range.

dataRange.description:
The range of data that the `data` field contains.
Has two keys, start and end.

title: The UI component that handles showing Spare Parts Inventory and Forecast data in a chart.
name: SparePartsForecastChart
